resolvedStack: Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma + NextAuth + Stripe
name: PulseLedger FinOps Cloud
description: PulseLedger FinOps Cloud is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform for automated cloud cost governance, invoice reconciliation, and budget anomaly alerts. It includes NextAuth authentication, Stripe subscription billing, Prisma PostgreSQL persistence, and interactive executive FinOps dashboards.

metadata.name: PulseLedger FinOps Cloud
metadata.description: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS for cloud spend governance, invoicing, and budget alerts.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Stripe, Zod, react-hook-form, lucide-react, react-icons.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role/InvoiceStatus/AlertSeverity enums and User, Invoice, BudgetAlert, Subscription models.
Shared TypeScript domain interfaces for Invoice, BudgetAlert, Subscription.
Tailwind CSS directives and clean custom styles.
Root layout wrapping SessionProvider, Navbar, main content, and Footer.
Next.js Edge middleware protecting /dashboard and /account while keeping /, /pricing, /login, /register, /api/auth public.
Public SaaS landing page for PulseLedger FinOps Cloud with hero, KPI metrics, and CTA to /dashboard and /pricing.
Credentials login page using NextAuth signIn with link to /register.
Registration page calling POST /api/register then NextAuth signIn and redirecting to /dashboard.
FinOps executive dashboard showing cloud spend KPIs, active invoices, and budget alerts.
Invoice management page with filtering, status badges, and new invoice creation modal.
Subscription pricing tiers page (Starter, Growth, Enterprise).
Client hook fetching /api/invoices with safe array fallback state.
User registration API using Zod safeParse, bcryptjs, and Prisma.
GET and POST API route for Invoice records with Zod validation and Prisma persistence.
GET and POST API route for BudgetAlert records.
